content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Can someone clarify why the technical specifications for the [product_name] mention support for 16 network connections, but when programming, only 8 connections seem possible? Thank you. [user_name]

The [product_name] can support up to 16 network connections, with a maximum of 8 static and 8 dynamic connections. Dynamic connections use the same connection terminal. In the provided example, you can observe that 16 connections are achievable.

analysis.insight_summary: The main user experience issue is a discrepancy between the technical documentation for [product_name], which describes support for 16 network connections, and what users can configure during programming—only 8 appear possible. The confusion arises from not recognizing the difference between static and dynamic network connections, which require separate setup approaches.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to configure up to 16 network connections, as indicated by the technical documentation for the [product_name], and want this capacity to be straightforward and clearly available during programming.
